in_hebrew.name: Bertie
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Bertie הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old German name Berhtari, meaning 'bright, shining'. The name was commonly used among the Germanic tribes and later adopted by the Anglo-Saxons. In the Middle Ages, it became a popular name in England and France.
